aws-api.description: Direct AWS API access for service operations. Requires AWS credentials configured.

aws-knowledge.description: AWS-managed remote server: documentation, regional availability, and architecture guidance. Nothing to install and no AWS credentials needed.

aws-docs.description: Search and retrieve AWS documentation for services and features.

aurora-postgres.description: Aurora PostgreSQL and RDS for PostgreSQL. Name the cluster or endpoint in chat when you ask it to connect. Read-only unless you add --allow_write_query to args.

prerequisites: AWS CLI configured with valid credentials
uv installed, for the uvx-launched servers
aws-knowledge is a remote server: no uv and no AWS credentials needed
regions: Ensure services (like Bedrock) are available in selected region
windows: AWS documents a different launch form on Windows: command 'uv' with args ['tool', 'run', '--from', '<package>@latest', '<package>.exe']; see each server's page at awslabs.github.io/mcp
superseded: As of November 7, 2026, AWS lists awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server as superseded by the managed AWS MCP Server. AWS's SigV4 entry for Kiro: command uvx, args mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp --metadata AWS_REGION=us-east-1 (needs local AWS credentials). If you switch, remove the aws-api and aws-knowledge entries so the agent does not see duplicate tools. See docs.aws.amazon.com/agent-toolkit/latest/userguide/getting-started-aws-mcp-server.html
retired: The AWS Diagram MCP server from the chapter's Phase 6 list is not included: every PyPI release is yanked, superseded by the diagram skill in AWS's deploy-on-aws agent plugin
security: Use IAM roles with least privilege
Never hardcode credentials in this file
Use AWS Secrets Manager for sensitive values
